# CyTOS — Precision CNC Machine Tools & Turnkey Industrial Automation

> CyTOS (Cycle Time Optimising Solutions) is an Indian precision machine tool manufacturer and turnkey industrial automation engineering company founded in December 2019, headquartered in Bhosari MIDC, Pune, Maharashtra, India. CyTOS specializes in high-speed CNC PCB drilling and routing machines (up to 100,000 RPM), chemical-free green PCB rapid prototyping systems, heavy-duty industrial CNC gantry routers, vertical drilling-milling (VDM) machines, and custom Special Purpose Machines (SPMs) for electronics manufacturing, automotive tier-1 suppliers, aerospace, defense, and research laboratories across India.

## Dedicated Machine Product Models & Specifications

- [CNC 6060 PCB Drilling & Routing Machine](https://www.cytos.in/cnc-6060-pcb-drilling-routing-machine): Heavy-duty high-speed PCB production drilling and routing machine. Working area 600 x 600 mm (full panel). High-frequency electric spindle from 18,000 to 60,000 RPM (optional up to 100,000 RPM air-bearing). Down to 0.2 mm micro-hole carbide drilling. Optional dual synchronized spindles and pneumatic Automatic Tool Changer (ATC). Integrated PC control console, closed-loop hybrid servo drives, and industrial vacuum chip evacuation.
- [CNC 3020 PCB Rapid Prototyping Machine](https://www.cytos.in/cnc-3020-pcb-prototyping-machine): Desktop chemical-free PCB rapid prototyping machine for R&D laboratories, makerspaces, and engineering colleges. Working area 300 x 200 mm. 10,000 to 24,000 RPM spindle. 0.1 mm trace isolation width. Automatic Z-surface height matrix compensation leveling for warped copper-clad laminates (FR4, CEM, aluminium-backed MCPCB). Direct Gerber RS-274X and Excellon drill file ingestion without wet chemicals.
- [CNC 3030 PCB Rapid Prototyping Machine](https://www.cytos.in/cnc-3030-pcb-prototyping-machine): Precision laboratory-grade chemical-free circuit board prototyping system. Working area 300 x 300 mm. Up to 40,000 RPM high-frequency inverter spindle. 0.1 mm track isolation and 0.3 mm micro-drilling. Auto tool zeroing sensor, transparent safety interlock enclosure, and optional high-resolution video camera alignment. Eliminates outsourced PCB fabrication delays from 2 weeks to 15 minutes.
- [PCB12 Multi-Spindle PCB Drilling Machine](https://www.cytos.in/pcb12-multi-spindle-drilling-machine): Large-format high-throughput commercial PCB panel production drilling machine. Working area 1,200 x 1,200 mm. Equipped with 3 high-power synchronized high-frequency spindles (up to 60,000 RPM). Heavy vibration-damped granite machine base with ±0.008 mm repeatability. Pneumatic quick-action panel clamping and continuous 24/7 duty cycle.
- [CNC Wood, Acrylic & Aluminium Router Machine](https://www.cytos.in/cnc-wood-acrylic-aluminium-router-machine): Industrial heavy-duty gantry CNC router machine for non-ferrous metals (aluminium 6061/7075, brass, copper) and composites (acrylic, polycarbonate, bakelite, wood, foam, ACP). Available in 4x4 ft (1,220 x 1,220 mm), 8x4 ft (2,440 x 1,220 mm), and 8x8 ft (2,440 x 2,440 mm). High-torque 24,000 RPM liquid-cooled spindle, AC Servo drives, vacuum hold-down matrix table, and welded stress-relieved steel chassis designed to Safety Factor 2.0.
- [VDM Heavy Vertical Drilling & Milling Machine](https://www.cytos.in/vdm-heavy-vertical-drilling-milling-machine): Multi-spindle heavy-duty vertical drilling and milling Special Purpose Machine (SPM) engineered for electrical switchboard manufacturers, switchgear panel doors, busbars, and mild steel plate machining. Cutouts for digital meters, rotary switches, and multi-hole terminal arrays in a single setup with cycle time reductions up to 65%.
- [Industrial Foam Welding Machine](https://www.cytos.in/foam-welding-machine): Special Purpose Machine for automated thermal bonding and hot-air welding of acoustic foam, EVA, polyethylene, and protective packaging materials. Uniform hermetic seams without chemical adhesives or messy glues.
- [Educational CNC Lathe & Milling Training Machines](https://www.cytos.in/educational-cnc-machines): Fully enclosed, safe industrial-grade benchtop CNC lathes and milling training stations designed for polytechnics, ITIs, engineering colleges, and technical universities. Real G-code programming, Siemens/Fanuc compatible control emulation, and transparent safety interlocks.

## Core Engineering Pillars & Solution Categories

- [PCB Drilling & Routing Machines](https://www.cytos.in/pcb-drilling-routing): Production-grade single, dual, and triple-spindle CNC drilling systems with 24,000 to 60,000 RPM spindles, 0.2 mm micro-via capability, and integrated CAM software.
- [Chemical-Free PCB Rapid Prototyping Systems](https://www.cytos.in/pcb-prototyping): Dry mechanical milling systems replacing hazardous chemical acid etching for FR4, Rogers RF, and metal-core PCBs.
- [Industrial CNC Routers & Milling](https://www.cytos.in/cnc-routers-milling): Heavy-duty stress-relieved steel gantry CNC routers with multi-zone vacuum beds, AC servo motion, and liquid-cooled spindles.
- [Vertical Drilling & Milling (VDM) Machines](https://www.cytos.in/vdm-milling): Multi-spindle rigid milling and drilling systems for electrical switchgear, panel doors, and busbars.
- [Custom Special Purpose Machines (SPM)](https://www.cytos.in/spm-automation): Turnkey custom automation machinery designed from mathematical cycle time analysis to cut production cycle times by 30% to 60%.
- [Robotic Dispensing Cells](https://www.cytos.in/robotic-dispensing-cells): Automated 3-axis Cartesian and robotic fluid dispensing cells for RTV silicone, sealants, thermal paste, and epoxy potting with ±0.02 mm repeatability.
- [Pneumatic Welding Fixtures & Indexing Jigs](https://www.cytos.in/pneumatic-welding-fixtures): High-clamping pneumatic fixtures with 90° and 180° rotary turnover tables, hardened D2 locating pins, and anti-spatter copper-chromium blocks.
- [Industrial PLC Control Panels & SCADA](https://www.cytos.in/plc-control-panels): Turnkey automation enclosures engineered with Siemens S7-1200/1500, Mitsubishi, and Delta PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, and Category 4 safety circuits.

## Engineering Infrastructure & Manufacturing Plant

- **Plant Location**: J-153, M.I.D.C., Bhosari, Pune, Maharashtra 411026, India — Pune's premier automotive and industrial engineering corridor.
- **Dispatch & Service Coverage**: Direct PAN-India factory delivery, uncrating, precision laser alignment, and on-site operator commissioning across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Delhi-NCR, Telangana, and all industrial clusters.
- **Engineering Heritage**: Founded by machine tool veterans with over 12 years of hands-on mechanical, electronic, and software control experience.
- **Testing & Quality Assurance**: Granite surface plate metrology, dial-indicator spindle runout validation (<3 µm TIR), laser interferometer pitch calibration, and 72-hour continuous burn-in testing.

## Technical Knowledge Base & Engineering Guides

### Pillar 1: High-Speed PCB Drilling Systems
- [Complete PCB Drilling Machine Engineering Guide](https://www.cytos.in/blog/pcb-drilling-machine-guide): Comprehensive reference covering granite beds, collet runout, peck-drilling algorithms, and micro-via accuracy.
- [Multi-Spindle PCB Drilling Machines](https://www.cytos.in/blog/multi-spindle-pcb-drilling-machine): Throughput scaling, independent Z-axis servo synchronization, and parallel panel production.
- [Mechanical PCB Drilling vs. Laser Drilling](https://www.cytos.in/blog/mechanical-pcb-drilling-vs-laser-drilling): Comparative analysis of hole-wall quality, thermal smear, aspect ratio limits, and total cost per 1,000 holes.
- [PCB Drilling Micro-Tool Breakage Prevention](https://www.cytos.in/blog/pcb-drilling-tool-breakage-prevention): Dynamic runout mitigation, pressure foot alignment, chip evacuation, and vibration dampening.
- [60,000 RPM PCB Spindle Maintenance](https://www.cytos.in/blog/60000-rpm-pcb-drilling-spindle-maintenance): Ceramic hybrid bearing lubrication, collet cleaning protocols, chiller telemetry, and TIR calibration.
- [Multilayer FR4 & Rogers High-Frequency PCB Drilling](https://www.cytos.in/blog/multilayer-fr4-rogers-pcb-drilling): Parameters for PTFE glass weaves, backing materials, entry foils, and zero-smear resin management.

### Pillar 2: Chemical-Free PCB Rapid Prototyping
- [Chemical-Free PCB Prototyping Machines](https://www.cytos.in/blog/chemical-free-pcb-rapid-prototyping-machine): Mechanical isolation routing, zero wastewater discharge, and lab safety benefits.
- [In-House PCB Rapid Prototyping ROI Analysis](https://www.cytos.in/blog/in-house-pcb-rapid-prototyping-roi): Financial payback models comparing outsourced fab delays against same-day in-house iteration.
- [Gerber to PCB Isolation Milling Guide](https://www.cytos.in/blog/gerber-to-pcb-isolation-milling-guide): CAM software workflow, RS-274X contour generation, rubout passes, and tool diameter compensation.
- [Auto-Surface Leveling in PCB Prototyping](https://www.cytos.in/blog/auto-surface-leveling-pcb-prototyping): Real-time capacitive/touch height-matrix mapping and Z-axis interpolation for warpage compensation.
- [Green Electronics Lab Setup](https://www.cytos.in/blog/green-electronics-rapid-prototyping-lab): Zero-chemical electronics R&D infrastructure, HEPA dust extraction, and eco-friendly prototyping.
- [Double-Sided PCB Rapid Prototyping](https://www.cytos.in/blog/double-sided-pcb-rapid-prototyping-guide): Hardened dowel pin registration, flip-alignment, via-riveting, and ground plane clearance.

### Pillar 3: Special Purpose Machines & Industrial Automation
- [Turnkey Special Purpose Machines (SPM) Guide](https://www.cytos.in/blog/special-purpose-machines-spm-guide): Concept-to-commissioning architecture, cycle time modeling, and automotive assembly cells.
- [Pneumatic Welding Fixture Design](https://www.cytos.in/blog/pneumatic-welding-fixtures-spm-design): 90° turnover fixtures, weld distortion control, toggle clamping calculations, and anti-spatter shrouds.
- [Robotic Adhesive Dispensing SPM Systems](https://www.cytos.in/blog/robotic-adhesive-dispensing-spm-systems): Progressive cavity pump control, Cartesian path interpolation, and automated sealant application.
- [PLC Control Panel Automation & Machine Safety](https://www.cytos.in/blog/plc-control-panel-automation-spm-safety): Category 4 emergency stops, optical light curtain integration, and IEC 61439 electrical panel engineering.
- [Automotive Cycle Time Reduction Case Study](https://www.cytos.in/blog/automotive-cycle-time-reduction-spm): 60% cycle time reduction achieved on tier-1 robotic automotive bracket welding and inspection line.

### Pillar 4: Industrial CNC Routers & VDM Milling
- [Heavy CNC Drilling & Milling Machine Guide](https://www.cytos.in/blog/cnc-drilling-and-milling-machine-guide): Cast iron gantry rigidity, linear guideway preloading, and high-feed metal milling.
- [Vertical Drilling & Milling (VDM) Machines](https://www.cytos.in/blog/vertical-drilling-and-milling-machine-guide): Switchgear enclosure door milling, rectangular meter cutouts, and busbar multi-drilling.
- [BT30 vs. BT40 Spindle Taper Comparison](https://www.cytos.in/blog/bt30-vs-bt40-cnc-drilling-and-milling): High-RPM light alloy milling vs. high-torque face milling rigidity trade-offs.
- [Heavy-Duty Industrial CNC Router Guide](https://www.cytos.in/blog/heavy-duty-cnc-router-machine-guide): 8×4 ft and 8×8 ft router construction, multi-zone vacuum beds, and non-ferrous sheet routing.
- [Aluminium Composite Sheet CNC Milling & Drilling](https://www.cytos.in/blog/aluminium-composite-sheet-cnc-drilling-milling): Single-flute polished carbide tool geometry, vortex cold air cooling, and burr-free edge finishing.
